proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Optimistic updates and rollback
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: Force DELETE 404 or transport failure. The cached row must be restored. Success must invalidate server data. Disable concurrent deletes or implement version-aware compensation.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: Snapshot rollback only remains correct when conflicting updates are serialized or reconciled; overlapping optimistic mutations need a more careful policy.

sourceContract.title: Optimistic updates and rollback
sourceContract.expectedPositive: Force DELETE 404 or transport failure. The cached row must be restored. Success must invalidate server data. Disable concurrent deletes or implement version-aware compensation.
sourceContract.expectedNegative: The starter removes the row in cache but never saves or restores the previous snapshot after an HTTP error.
sourceContract.securityBoundary: Snapshot rollback only remains correct when conflicting updates are serialized or reconciled; overlapping optimistic mutations need a more careful policy.
